---
title: "run gsea gls astrocytes"
output: html_document
date: "2026-09-19"
---

```{r setup}
library(BPCells)
library(tidyverse)
library(sccomp)
library(readxl)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
set.seed(1)
```

```{r}
dreamlet_results <- qs2::qs_read("../shared objs and code/dreamlet_de_results_all_contrasts.qs2")

comparisons_of_interest <- dreamlet_results$comparison %>% unique
dreamlet_results_selected <- dreamlet_results %>%
  filter(comparison %in% comparisons_of_interest)
```

```{r}
gls_astrocytes_df <- dreamlet_results_selected %>%
  filter(cluster == "GLS-astrocytes")

# Loop over each contrast
gsea_results_list <- list()

for (contrast in comparisons_of_interest) {
  
  cur_data <- gls_astrocytes_df %>%
    filter(comparison == contrast) %>%
    arrange(-logFC)
  
  # Build named gene list (ranked by logFC)

  cur_genelist <- cur_data$logFC
  names(cur_genelist) <- cur_data$gene
  cur_genelist <- sort(cur_genelist, decreasing = TRUE)
  
  cur_fgsea = gseGO(geneList = cur_genelist,
                        OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
                        ont = "BP",
                        keyType = "SYMBOL",
                        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                        pvalueCutoff = 1,#don't remove any 
                        by = "fgsea",
                        nPermSimple = 50000,
                        seed = TRUE,
                        eps = 1e-50,
                        verbose = FALSE)
  
  if (nrow(as.data.frame(cur_fgsea)) > 0) {
    gsea_results_list[[contrast]] <- cur_fgsea %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      mutate(contrast = contrast)
  }
}

# Combine all results
all_gsea_results <- bind_rows(gsea_results_list)
saveRDS(all_gsea_results, "gsea_results_gls_astrocytes.rds")
qs2::qs_save(all_gsea_results, "gsea_results_gls_astrocytes.qs2")
```
